author_inference_review: 160 matched inputs and4 resets passed on macOS and Linux, including author legacy KV window reset transitions. Maximum motor-target difference 2.15e-6 rad on macOS and8.35e-7 rad on Linux. Full-suite verification is separate.
benchmark_physics: shared G1 canonical profile, not the author training simulator
redistribution: checkpoint not distributed in Git; obtain from recorded upstream URL under its original terms

checkpoint_origin.verification: The adapter pins this published artifact by SHA256. Artifact identity is separate from inference parity.

deployment.legacy_rope: The original checkpoint has an 8192-position RoPE table but no rope_max_seq_len metadata. The pinned author runtime explicitly supports a legacy maximum-length override. Set max length8192 and its default margin64; zero KV cache and local step index at8128 without changing the reference frame or simulation state.
deployment.observation: Original v1.3.1 author config, 522D input, current state plus 10 future references at50Hz. Matched against current author observation evaluator.
deployment.reset: Independent motion starts clear KV cache, step index and last action. Cache-window resets retain action history and reference time.
deployment.output: Author float32 scale and default-pose PD target; no model-specific change to benchmark physics.
